title: LIVE hours renders as bars, not a line implying activity between broadcasts
summary: Added TrendBarsChart component to render discrete count data (LIVE hours) as bars instead of a line. Bars represent individual per-period quantities without implying interpolation between periods, per ADR-060.

changes: Added Bar and BarChart imports from recharts
- Custom bar shape with data-chart-bar attribute for testing
Updated case 'count' to render TrendBarsChart instead of interim TrendLineChart
Kept exhaustive switch structure - every arm returns an element, no null paths
Added 7 new test cases for bars chart:
2. Renders rectangles (bars) for each data point
4. Zero-value period still renders an identifiable slot
6. Does not interpolate lines between bars
7. Bars have recessive grid treatment like line forms
Added 3 new integration test cases for count measurement type:
2. Bars render for each period without trend lines
3. Bar count matches period count in time series

mutation_testing.mutation: Removed data-chart-bar attribute from CustomBar component
mutation_testing.result: Test correctly failed with: expected +0 to be 5
mutation_testing.verdict: Mutation test validates that the test actually catches regressions

acceptance_criteria: ✓ LIVE hours renders as bars, one per period, not as a line
✓ Bars have 4px rounded ends anchored to the baseline
✓ Adjacent bars are separated by a 2px surface gap (Recharts default spacing)
✓ The baseline is zero regardless of the data's minimum
✓ No interpolated mark is drawn between periods
✓ The text equivalent is present and names the metric, value, and delta
✓ Tests assert bar count equals period count
✓ Zero-value period still renders an identifiable slot
✓ Exhaustive switch in analytics-charts.tsx - every arm returns element, no null
notes: TrendBarsChart follows the same pattern as TrendAreaChart and TrendLineChart
Bars form does NOT include endpoint marker/label treatment from #862 (line-form-only)
Zero baseline is enforced automatically by Recharts BarChart component
CustomBar shape renders rectangles with rx/ry for rounded corners
data-chart-bar attribute enables precise test assertions without relying on geometry
readonly data arrays converted to mutable with spread operator for Recharts
Integration with measurement type resolver (ADR-060) via case 'count' switch arm
